Title: HomePageComponent — Marketing Landing Page
Summary: The main landing page for Cyréna.dev. Communicates that Cyréna is an offline-first, model-agnostic desktop application (not a SaaS or AI model). Features hero with accent badge, "What Cyréna Actually Is" trait cards, Ollama/OpenAI side-by-side model showcase with switch visual, The Four Pillars, multi-domain support, API references code window, reality check, platform vision, and open source CTA.

### The Four Pillars (features signal)

1. **Extensions** (`bi-puzzle`) — Expand Cyréna beyond coding with custom integrations, workflows, and business-specific tooling. Build what your team needs.
2. **Coding** (`bi-code-slash`) — Where it all started. Deep support for .NET, PlatformIO, Arduino — and now Angular too. More ecosystems on the way.
3. **Offline-First & Model Agnostic** (`bi-shield-lock`) — Work offline with local models via Ollama, or go online with OpenAI. Switch models in any chat at any time. Your choice, always.
4. **Your Ideas** (`bi-lightbulb`) — Build anything. From prototypes to production systems, Cyréna helps you turn ideas into working software.

### New Features (newFeatures signal) — "What's New / Built for Control"

Four upcoming capabilities displayed in a 4-card grid after the Model Agnostic section:

1. **Feature Activation** (`bi-toggle-on`) — Enable or disable tools and capabilities per chat. When a feature is off, it ceases to exist for the model entirely. No confusion, no accidental tool use, no noise. Image: `images/guides/feature-activation.png`.
2. **Dynamic System Prompts** (`bi-file-earmark-text`) — As features activate and deactivate, Cyréna's instruction set updates automatically. Stack-specific constraints applied without a static one-size-fits-all prompt. No image.
3. **Prompt Queuing** (`bi-stack`) — Queue a sequence of instructions and let Cyréna work through them automatically. Each response completes before the next fires. Auto-pause on critical input. Image: `images/guides/prompt-queue.png`.
4. **Chat Status** (`bi-activity`) — Live status of every chat in the sidebar: Unloaded (idle), Loaded (context ready), Working (actively processing). Image: `images/guides/chat-status.png`.

Each card shows: icon + title + "New" badge, tagline in primary color, description paragraph, optional screenshot image, and 4 bullet-point features.

### Cyréna Remembers Section (Memory System)

Three cards in a dark section (`bg-dark`):

1. **Sticky Notes** (`bi-sticky`, yellow accent) — Quick notes, rules, and reminders the AI writes for itself. Architectural decisions, coding conventions, things not to forget. Lightweight and fast to scan.
2. **API References** (`bi-journal-code`, cyan accent) — Deep technical documentation for intense coding. Service contracts, integration patterns, real signatures grounded in actual code.
3. **The .cyrena Folder** (`bi-folder2-open`, green accent) — Both memory systems saved in a `.cyrena` folder at the project's root. Just files. Source-controllable. Shareable. Visual shows folder tree: `my-project/` → `src/`, `.cyrena/` (bold) → `sticky-notes/`, `api-references/`, `package.json`.

Below the cards, a two-column callout:
- **Model Handoff, Zero Friction** — Switch from Ollama to OpenAI mid-project and the new model reads the same memory. No need to re-explain the codebase or rebuild context from scratch.
- **Team Handoff, Same Story** — Commit `.cyrena` to Git. Another developer clones the repo, opens Cyréna, and the AI already knows the architecture, the rules, and the intent. No onboarding docs required.

### Key Messaging

- Cyréna is a **desktop app**, not a web service
- Cyréna is **model-agnostic** — orchestrates LLMs, not an LLM itself
- Users can **switch models mid-chat** (Ollama ↔ OpenAI)
- Cyréna is **extensible** via extensions (never "plugins")
- Supports .NET, Arduino, PlatformIO, **and Angular**
- Two-part memory system: **Sticky Notes** (quick rules) + **API References** (deep docs)
- Memory lives in `.cyrena` folder — source-controllable, shareable, enables model and team handoff
- **New features**: Feature Activation, Dynamic System Prompts, Prompt Queuing, Chat Status
- Open source, runs on your machine, no server
